after.questionText: Which courageous plan best compares performing on his values with skipping the tryout?
after.scenarioText: Zeke wants to try out for the talent show, but his stomach flips when he sees the signup sheet. Friends in his project group are signing up around him. His brain says, "Maybe we become invisible today." He compares two plans: sign up now while nervous, or skip to protect himself from embarrassment. During the courage challenge, Zeke weighs which tradeoff best matches what he values.
